videomama.label: VideoMaMa UNet checkpoint

The HF repo has unet/ at top level; path_remap unet/ -> VideoMaMa/unet/ implements it.

The legacy setup_models.py rename unet/ -> VideoMaMa/ produced VideoMaMa/{config,diffusion...} directly, which does NOT satisfy the loader (searched subfolder unet/ missing). Installs with that flat layout must be repaired to the nested layout; detection now checks the nested closure.
Requires the SVD img2vid-xt base (videomama-svd) for image encoder, feature extractor and temporal VAE.

meta.verification_policy: verified=true requires every required file to match a trusted sha256 recorded in the local stat-keyed hash cache. Files or artifacts without trusted hashes report verified=false with reason no-trusted-hash. Unresolved metadata can never report verified.
